protocol_notes: The archived model uses a 64x1024 range-view feature map.
Historical training used four GPUs with global batch size 8.
The fixed-seed evaluation protocol uses seed 666.
Four evaluation ranks and global batch size 8 were used.
Each rank used seed 666 plus its global rank.
The released nuScenes primary uses TransFusionHead.

argoverse2.evaluation: official AV2 implementation with the paper's 200 m ROI-only protocol
protocol_notes: The 200 m ROI-only setting is a paper protocol, not the default 150 m AV2 leaderboard setting.
Distance-annulus values use the official formula on independently filtered annuli.
Training used seed 666, global batch size 16, and RV_VOX_CHUNK=512; epoch 1 used AMP and epochs 2-12 resumed in FP32 without bitwise-continuous RNG state.

reporting_policy.note: Only archived measured results are recorded here; paper-constrained synthetic projections are intentionally excluded.
